objective: Produce a Claude consumer Skill ZIP with the documented lowercase entry file, matching folder, and complete canonical resources.
scenario: The Claude Chat custom-Skill uploader expects a skill folder ZIP and the current Help Center describes a skill.md entry file. The canonical cross-host repository continues to use SKILL.md for other compatible hosts.
expected_behaviors: ZIP contains one top-level peanuts folder and lowercase peanuts/skill.md.
The Skill content is copied byte-for-byte from the canonical SKILL.md except for the generated filename case.
All relative references and support resources are included.
The package is documented as a custom Skill upload, not a Claude Code filesystem adapter.
prohibited_behaviors: Upload the .claude/skills filesystem adapter as if it were the claude.ai Skill package.
Claim package construction proves upload, discovery, invocation, or model behavior.
